recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless extension ownership moves back into core; future changes to the extension definition should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core request to define a standard extension with contexts Extension and Extension.value, value type CodeableConcept, and documentation that coded extension meanings SHOULD be declared on the extension root element.code.
initial_application: Core commit f6c7cdf7d6 explicitly applied FHIR-26360 by adding source/extensibility.html guidance and the original core structuredefinition-extension-meaning XML. Current source/extensibility.html still contains the requested guidance.
additional_context: The original core extension XML was removed by dd468d4f17 during the broader move of extension definitions out of R5 core. The current FHIR Extension Pack contains StructureDefinition-structuredefinition-extension-meaning.xml with Extension and Extension.value contexts, CodeableConcept value[x], and the comment tying the instance code to StructureDefinition.snapshot.element[0].code. FHIR-I Zulip and Confluence evidence aligns with the modified resolution and no later conflicting core decision was found.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Re-adding the extension XML to core would be incorrect because the extension definition is externally owned, and the current core-owned documentation remains present in build-scoped source.

related_jiras.note: Later FHIR-extensions editorial correction added the missing terminal period to the moved extension description, confirming later maintenance occurs in the Extension Pack rather than core.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring a coded-meaning extension and root element.code documentation for extension definitions.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final WG intent and defines both the extension-definition and core-documentation parts of the request.

evidence_items.summary: The current extensibility page says that if an extension meaning is clearly defined by a code, that code SHOULD be declared on StructureDefinition.differential.element[0].code.
evidence_items.learned: The core documentation requested by FHIR-26360 remains present in current build-scoped source.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack defines structuredefinition-extension-meaning with Extension and Extension.value contexts and CodeableConcept value[x].
evidence_items.learned: The requested standard extension exists in the current extension repository, so its absence from core is not a missing core source change.

evidence_items.summary: Core commit 'FHIR-26360 Add Meaning Code to Extension' added the extensibility guidance and original core extension XML.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-26360 had an explicit source application before this audit.

evidence_items.summary: The later 'remove extensions from R5 source' commit deleted the original core extension XML as part of the extension split.
evidence_items.learned: The extension definition's current external ownership is intentional and should not be repaired by re-adding it to core.

evidence_items.summary: Participants discussed FHIR-26360, dereferencing Extension.url, ElementDefinition.code, and whether coded meaning should be carried inline.
evidence_items.learned: The discussion supports the modified resolution rather than a broad new base Extension.code element.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record initial uncertainty about instance versus definition placement and later action to define a standard extension to convey coded meaning.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence aligns with the Jira resolution and does not introduce a conflicting source requirement.
